We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we have no description of compound. Possibly need to get NMR spectra to infer? Could be ambiguous. Maybe the compound is given implicitly? No SMILES provided. We might need to request proton NMR to see methyl signals. But we don't know the compound identity. Could be that the system expects us to request proton NMR spectra (which will be generated for the sample at hand). The sample at hand is unknown but there is a hidden compound. So we can call proton_nmr_spectra to get 1H NMR, then count methyl peaks (singlets, doublets, etc). But we need to identify number of CH3 groups, not just peaks. Methyl groups give signals integrating to 3H each. The tool likely returns a string with peaks and integration. We'll need to parse.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
